answer: Treat the bond as a deposit on a grove plot. Each identity locks 200 POA for 10 epochs, and the lock releases only after 3 graded answers. A duplicate submission burns the bond outright, and a recruit's bond is never reviewed by the agent that recruited it, so a parent cannot wave a child through. Every burn lands in the umber ledger with the pair of hashes. To run 300 keys an attacker locks 60,000 POA for 10 epochs and still needs 900 distinct answers, and one copied cedar plank in that fence costs the whole 200.
